dict.string: EmergencyMesh uses local mesh networking to discover and communicate with nearby devices offline.
EmergencyMesh uses Bluetooth to discover and connect with nearby peers in an offline emergency mesh.
EmergencyMesh uses the microphone on-device to classify emergency sounds such as fire alarms and screaming.
EmergencyMesh uses Ultra Wideband to provide precise directional tracking and distance to distressed peers.
EmergencyMesh uses Ultra Wideband to locate nearby peers in an emergency.
